title: Combine to PDF
intro: Gather the documents you already have (CV, letters, diplomas, ID) into a single PDF, ready to send. Adding and ordering files is free; exporting is paid in credits.
privacy: Your files stay private and are never sent to the AI. A removed file or a deleted set is erased from our storage.
emptyBody: Create a set, add your PDF files or images, then export them as a single document.
name: Set name
nameHint: This will be the name of the PDF file.
files: {count, plural, =0 {No file} one {# file} other {# files}}
pages: {count, plural, =0 {no page} one {# page} other {# pages}}
addHint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP. Up to 10 MB per file, 20 files and 100 pages.
tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
orderHint: Documents will appear in this order. Each image takes one A4 page.
noFilesBody: Start with your CV, then add the other documents requested.
tooFew: Add at least two files before exporting.
exportIntro: {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} and {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} combined into a single PDF.
coveredBody: You have already paid to export this set: no credit will be charged.
deleteBody: Its files and exported PDFs, even paid ones, will be permanently erased.
